latestVersion.changelog:
Jagran Invitation Video Maker Free — Initial Release

- Launches v1.0.0 with cloud-based Jagran-style invitation video creation.
- Supports uploading MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG files up to 200MB; processes user images, text, and instructions into festive invitation videos.
- Provides automatic setup with free 100-credit, 7-day tokens for new users.
- Exports 1080p MP4 invitation videos with date, venue, and music, ready in 1–2 minutes.
- Includes simple text/image input, session management, cloud render pipeline, and clear user feedback for status and exports.
